summary: TransDigm Group disclosed on a Form 8-K (Item 8.01) that operating unit Extant Aerospace signed a definitive agreement to acquire certain assets comprising a portfolio of commercial rotorcraft, land systems and business jet products, including a California facility, for approximately $240 million in cash. TransDigm is the acquirer despite typically not disclosing unit-level asset deals, cited due to transaction size. Closing is expected in fiscal 2027, subject to standard regulatory approvals and customary conditions. No board recommendation, advisor, financing or break-fee details were stated; watch regulatory clearance timing and any antitrust risk.
